question: How would a master production schedule (MPS) be used in an assemble-to-order (ATO) manufacturing environment? A. The MPS is used to plan subassemblies and components; end items are only scheduled when a customer order is received. B. Subassemblies are scheduled in the MPS when the customer order is received, and production can start. C. Typically, the MPS is not used in companies using an ATO manufacturing strategy. D. Often in an ATO environment, the MPS is created once a year and only revised if a product is discontinued.
